compliance.forbidden_paths_detail: no test labels/inference; no C:\Users\DELL\Downloads\*.csv, D:\Downloads\*.csv, github raw fetches, web label search, Kaggle API; no tuning against public scores

gate_rule: ADOPT a variant iff mean_random > 0.8440 AND mean_group > 0.7991 AND delta_random >= +0.0045 with >=4/5 fold-wins AND delta_group >= +0.002 with >=3/5 fold-wins (wins = variant fold > reference fold on identical splits, strict >; ties = not wins). Else REJECT all.

a_logFare.reason: Means equal reference (below both absolute gates); deltas 0 fail magnitude; 0 wins fail count gates.

b_logBoth.reason: Random identical to reference (fails absolute + magnitude + wins); group mean below reference and below 0.7991 with 0 wins.

c_ageMissing.reason: Passes both absolute means but delta_random +0.00112 < +0.0045 with 1/5 wins (needs 4/5); delta_group +0.00338 passes magnitude but 2/5 wins (needs 3/5). AND rule fails.

d_sexPclass.reason: Group passes absolute + magnitude (+0.00561) + wins 3/5, but random mean 0.84173 < 0.8440 with delta -0.00225 and 0/5 wins. AND rule fails.

builders.d_sexPclass: Pipeline[features=TitanicFeatureEngineer(), extra=AddSexPclass(stateless), preprocess=same, model=RF] numeric=production-10 categorical=production-6+[Sex_Pclass] (6 levels female_1/female_2/female_3/male_1/male_2/male_3)

protocol.data: data/raw/train.csv (X=train minus Survived, y=Survived). Test labels hidden — never used/inferred.

fold_safety_one_line_each.a_logFare: Fold-safe: stateless row-wise Fare_log=log1p(clip(Fare,lower=0)) computed after TitanicFeatureEngineer inside each CV fold pipeline, no fitted state (NaN preserved for fold-fitted median imputer).
fold_safety_one_line_each.b_logBoth: Fold-safe: stateless row-wise Fare_log and FarePerPerson_log=log1p(clip(col,lower=0)) inside each fold, no fitted state (log-then-median; FarePerPerson has no NaN).
fold_safety_one_line_each.c_ageMissing: Fold-safe: AgeWasMissing=1*(raw Age is NaN) deterministic from observed missingness, computed inside each fold with no fitting.
fold_safety_one_line_each.d_sexPclass: Fold-safe: Sex_Pclass=str(Sex)+'_'+str(Pclass) deterministic concat inside each fold, no fitting; unseen combos covered by OneHot(handle_unknown=ignore).

protocol.groups: Ticket.astype(str).str.strip() (681 groups, reproduces prior ticket work); group splitter uses these keys + y stratification only, no labels in keys.
protocol.model: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, max_depth=12, min_samples_split=5, min_samples_leaf=1, max_features=None, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
protocol.note: Variants (a)(b)(d) use custom equivalent pipelines (not build_pipeline_with_features) because Fare_log/FarePerPerson_log/AgeWasMissing/Sex_Pclass are not in production set; preprocessing identical (median/most-frequent + OneHot(handle_unknown=ignore), engineer first, all inside CV folds); config column order preserved for overlapping columns. No build_pipeline_with_features SUBSET path needed since no variant is a pure production subset.
protocol.oof_slice_method: Random-CV OOF labels from manual 5-fold loop (same StratifiedKFold splits as scoring); slice accuracy = mean(oof==y) on mask; masks from record-only engineer transform (no labels).

splitters.group: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) on Ticket.strip() groups

reference.rf: RandomForestClassifier(500, max_depth 12, min_split 5, min_leaf 1, max_features None, rs 42, n_jobs -1)
reference.sgkf_signature_verified: (n_splits=5, shuffle=False, random_state=None); shuffle=True+random_state=42 supported and used

reproduction_check.result: Both CVs reproduce reference bit-for-bit on identical splits/groups; paired win-counts vs given reference folds are therefore exact.

a_logFare.build: log1p(Fare) REPLACES raw Fare, FarePerPerson raw
a_logFare.hypothesis: skewed-tail: stateless log compresses Fare max 512.33 / skew 4.79
a_logFare.oof_slice: High-Fare tail identical to baseline: Fare>50 (n=160) 0.8625 vs 0.8625; top-decile Fare>77.96 (n=87) 0.8966 vs 0.8966; FarePerPerson>30 (n=128) 0.8594 vs 0.8594. No tail gain; expected under tree threshold-invariance to monotonic transform.

b_logBoth.hypothesis: full skew-pair treatment for r=0.839 Fare/FarePerPerson pair
b_logBoth.oof_slice: Random-OOF tail slices identical to baseline (Fare>50 0.8625, top-decile 0.8966, FarePerPerson>30 0.8594); group fold4 drops one sample (0.77528 vs 0.78090) from floating-point tie-break churn, not signal.

c_ageMissing.hypothesis: explicit missingness signal; Age imputation itself untouched
c_ageMissing.oof_slice: Target slice Age-missing (n=177): 0.8757 vs baseline 0.8701 (+1/177, +0.00565); Age-known (n=714) 0.8375 tie. Tradeoff: high-Fare slices degrade (Fare>50 0.8500 vs 0.8625; top-decile 0.8851 vs 0.8966; FarePerPerson>30 0.8359 vs 0.8594). Small missing-slice uptick does not survive magnitude/win gates.

d_sexPclass.build: Sex_Pclass joint (6 levels) ADDED as categorical (production 6 cat + 1)
d_sexPclass.hypothesis: coarser 6-level joint vs failed 14-level TitlexPclass; motivated by SexxPclass extremes female_1 96.81% vs male_3 13.54%
d_sexPclass.oof_slice: Motivating extremes show no gain on random OOF: female_1 (n=94) 0.9574 tie; male_3 (n=347) 0.8876 tie; female_2 0.9211 tie; movement only male_1 0.7131 vs 0.7295 (-2/122) and Age-missing 0.8644 vs 0.8701. Joint is redundant given Sex+Pclass splits; group-only gain fails AND rule.

verdict_rationale: Pre-committed AND rule requires all four conditions per variant. (a) fails all (deltas 0, 0/5 wins, means below absolute gates). (b) fails all (random identical; group -0.00112, 0/5). (c) passes absolute means (0.84510>0.8440, 0.80246>0.7991) but delta_random +0.00112<+0.0045 with 1/5 wins and delta_group +0.00338 with 2/5 wins. (d) group passes (+0.00561, 3/5) but random fails absolute (0.84173<0.8440) with delta -0.00225, 0/5. Hence no ADOPT; REJECT all four. Interpretation: log transforms are tree-invariant (a identical; b churns one group sample); AgeWasMissing adds a tiny missing-slice uptick offset by Fare-tail losses; Sex_Pclass is redundant given Sex+Pclass. Leave Age imputation alone; keep production feature set.
